description: Implementation of CategoryService for managing category hierarchy, including methods for retrieving categories, building nested category structures, and collecting category IDs and marks.

classes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for category management, providing methods to retrieve categories and their hierarchical structure, and to gather category IDs and marks.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all categories, constructs a nested category list, and returns it wrapped in a ResponseVo.

methods.name: getCategoryIdAndMarkSet
methods.description: Collects all category IDs and marks under a given category ID, including subcategories.

methods.name: getCategoryIdAndMarkSet (private)
methods.description: Recursive helper to gather category IDs and marks for subcategories.

methods.name: fillRootList
methods.description: Builds nested subcategory lists for each parent category.

methods.name: createRootList
methods.description: Creates the top-level list of categories with parent ID equal to ROOT_CATEGORY_PARENT_ID.

methods.name: categoryToVo
methods.description: Converts a Category object to a CategoryVo object.
